sentences.zh: 我曾在凌晨4点半给总统打电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空中的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的外面是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔韦尔尼西，这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: On the first night of the Democratic National Convention, the stage belonged to the man who chose to give it up.
sentences.zh: 在民主党全国代表大会的第一晚，舞台属于那个选择放弃这一切的人。

sentences.en: Today, I spoke with my colleagues Katie Rogers and Peter Baker about Joe Biden's private pain since stepping aside and his public message here in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 今天，我同我的同事凯蒂·罗杰斯和彼得·贝克谈论了乔·拜登自退出以来内心的痛苦，以及他在芝加哥传递的公开信息。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, August 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月20日，星期二。

sentences.en: Is this the line we need to get on?
sentences.zh: 这是我们要排的队吗？

sentences.en: This is the line.
sentences.zh: 这就是队。

sentences.en: Oh, gosh.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: I'd say we're going to be here 45 minutes or so.
sentences.zh: 我想我们大概得在这里待45分钟左右。

sentences.en: My goodness.
sentences.zh: 我的天啊。

sentences.en: At least nice birds and flowers here.
sentences.zh: 好歹这里有漂亮的鸟儿和花朵。

sentences.en: A little butterfly.
sentences.zh: 一只小蝴蝶。

sentences.en: Oh, there it is.
sentences.zh: 哦，它在那儿。

sentences.en: I can see the United Center now.
sentences.zh: 我现在能看到联合中心了。

sentences.en: See, it's through the...
sentences.zh: 看，它穿过……

sentences.en: Yeah, but can you see the front of the line?
sentences.zh: 对，但你能看到队伍的最前面吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不能。

sentences.en: Line, line, line.
sentences.zh: 排队，排队，排队。

sentences.en: I feel like the season is passing as we're, like, waiting.
sentences.zh: 我觉得在我们像这样等待的时候，时间都过去了。

sentences.en: There's, like, a cicada coming up.
sentences.zh: 好像有一只蝉爬上来了。

sentences.en: I see some leaves turning.
sentences.zh: 我看到一些树叶变黄了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Oh, is this the end?
sentences.zh: 哦，这是尽头吗？

sentences.en: Okay, so we're through the line.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们排过队了。

sentences.en: It was, indeed, 45 minutes, as I predicted.
sentences.zh: 正如我所料，确实花了45分钟。

sentences.en: And we are standing outside a giant building with a big blue sign on it that says Democratic National Convention.
sentences.zh: 我们正站在一栋巨大的建筑外，上面挂着一个写着“民主党全国代表大会”的大蓝牌子。

sentences.en: And it is Kamala Harris's convention.
sentences.zh: 这是卡玛拉·哈里斯的大会。

sentences.en: It is her week.
sentences.zh: 这是她的周。

sentences.en: But it is Joe Biden's night.
sentences.zh: 但这是乔·拜登的夜晚。

sentences.en: Tonight, he's going to take the stage,
sentences.zh: 今晚，他将走上舞台，

sentences.en: give a speech to an entire party who forced him out.
sentences.zh: 向一个逼他退出的整个党派发表演讲。

sentences.en: And many of us know the broad story of how he decided to step aside.
sentences.zh: 我们许多人都知道他决定退出的总体故事。

sentences.en: But the question always has been,
sentences.zh: 但问题一直是，

sentences.en: what was the thing in the end that fundamentally made him drop out?
sentences.zh: 究竟是什么最终从根本上促使他退选的？

sentences.en: But my colleague Katie Rogers has gotten inside the final few days for Biden in making that decision.
sentences.zh: 不过我的同事凯蒂·罗杰斯已经深入了解了拜登做出这一决定前的最后几天。

sentences.en: So we're going to go talk to her about what ultimately drove Biden to make this decision to leave the race.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要去和她谈谈，究竟是什么最终驱使拜登做出了离开竞选的决定。

sentences.en: Okay, big New York Times area.
sentences.zh: 好的，很大的《纽约时报》区域。

sentences.en: Maybe seeing a lot of other people I know.
sentences.zh: 也许会看到很多我认识的其他面孔。

sentences.en: Oh, here she is.
sentences.zh: 哦，她来了。

sentences.en: Katie.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂。

sentences.en: Hi, how are you?
sentences.zh: 嗨，你好吗？

sentences.en: Are you ready?
sentences.zh: 准备好了吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Welcome.
sentences.zh: 欢迎。

sentences.en: We're so glad to have you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能来。

sentences.en: So, Katie, just to start, I wonder if you could reflect for a moment about what this convention was supposed to be up until a month ago.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂，首先，我想请你回想一下，直到一个月前，这次大会本该是什么样子的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, this is something that President Biden had been looking forward to.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是拜登总统一直期待的事情。

sentences.en: He had been workshopping a big convention speech.
sentences.zh: 他一直在打磨一篇大型的大会演讲。

sentences.en: You know, this is something that Biden didn't get in 2020.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是拜登在2020年没有得到的。

sentences.en: If you remember, we were in the middle of a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 如果你还记得的话，我们正处于大流行期间。

sentences.en: This was all done virtually for him.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是为他虚拟进行的。

sentences.en: This would have been the very first time in his career that he was the presidential nominee at a huge 50,000-person-strong convention.
sentences.zh: 这将是他职业生涯中头一次在拥有整整五万人的巨大代表大会上成为总统候选人。

sentences.en: You know, you get the balloons.
sentences.zh: 你知道，会有气球。

sentences.en: You get the big banners with your Bidenisms broadcast everywhere.
sentences.zh: 会有巨大的横幅，上面到处广播着你的“拜登式语录”。

sentences.en: It was a moment this president doesn't really ever get to have.
sentences.zh: 这是这位总统实际上从未有机会经历的时刻。

sentences.en: I mean, it's been a moment he's wanted for decades, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是他几十年来一直想要的一刻，对吧？

sentences.en: So many people cheering for him and choosing him in a way.
sentences.zh: 有那么多人为他欢呼，某种程度上选择了他。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's the validation.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是认可。

sentences.en: He has wanted the validation of being that choice and will not get that now.
sentences.zh: 他一直想要那种成为这种选择的认可，而现在却得不到了。

sentences.en: Instead of this moment where he gets to, you know, lay the groundwork for a second term, he is ending his political career in Chicago on stage.
sentences.zh: 他本该迎来一个为第二个任期奠定基础的时刻，结果却要在芝加哥的舞台上结束自己的政治生涯。

sentences.en: Katie, you and our colleagues have been reporting on why he decided to give up something he wanted so badly.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂，你和我们的同事一直在报道他为什么决定放弃一个他如此渴望的东西。

sentences.en: Tell us about what you found.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲你们发现了什么。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So it starts almost exactly a month ago.
sentences.zh: 所以这几乎正好始于一个月前。

sentences.en: The president is campaigning and comes down with COVID and is rushed home on Air Force One to his beach home in Rehoboth in Delaware.
sentences.zh: 总统在进行竞选活动时感染了新冠，并乘坐“空军一号”被紧急送回特拉华州里霍博斯的的海滩住宅。

sentences.en: There he is joined by his wife, Jill Biden, the first lady.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他的妻子、第一夫人吉尔·拜登陪伴着他。

sentences.en: And there are two other aides who are very close to him.
sentences.zh: 还有另外两名与他非常亲密的助手。

sentences.en: Another key advisor was in Rehoboth at the time, sort of on standby, named Steve Reschetti.
sentences.zh: 当时里霍博斯还有另一位核心顾问，有点像在待命，名叫史蒂夫·里谢蒂。

sentences.en: He's the keeper of the president's political relationship.
sentences.zh: 他是总统政治关系的守护者。

sentences.en: So a lot of the party leaders were funneling their alarm and their worry and their unhappiness through Steve Reschetti.
sentences.zh: 因此，许多党内领袖都通过史蒂夫·里谢蒂倾注他们的惊恐、担忧和不满。

sentences.en: So Friday, the president was sick and didn't really get out of bed much.
sentences.zh: 所以周五时总统病了，几乎没怎么下床。

sentences.en: He read the papers by the pool.
sentences.zh: 他在泳池边看报纸。

sentences.en: The next day, though, he gets on the phone, calls Steve Reschetti and says, I need you and Mike at the house.
sentences.zh: 不过第二天，他拿起电话，打电话给史蒂夫·里谢蒂说，我需要你和迈克来家里。

sentences.en: And Mike is Mike Donilon, the president's most senior strategist, the writer of his speeches, really the keeper of the Biden flame, if you will.
sentences.zh: 迈克是迈克·多尼隆，总统最高级的战略家、他的演讲撰稿人，可以说是拜登精神的守护者，如果你愿意这么说的话。

sentences.en: Well, Biden, Reschetti and Donilon go over the polling, go over what people in the party are saying and essentially say to the president,
sentences.zh: 嗯，拜登、里谢蒂和多尼隆过了一遍民调，过了一遍党内人士的说法，基本上对总统说：

sentences.en: look, if you want to do this, we can get you there.
sentences.zh: 听着，如果你想这样做，我们能帮你办到。

sentences.en: We have been around all of us long enough to know that the polling can be wrong.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都在这圈子里够久了，知道民调可能是错的。

sentences.en: We can get you there.
sentences.zh: 我们能帮你挺过去。

sentences.en: It's sort of a cultural belief in the Biden circle to not discount polls, but to look at them and say, well, we have been here before, but it is going to be a climb
sentences.zh: 拜登核心圈子里有一种文化信仰，就是不忽视民调，而是看着它们说，好吧，我们以前也经历过这种情况，但这将会是一场苦战，

sentences.en: and you are going to do it alone without the support of Democratic Party leaders.
sentences.zh: 而且你将孤军奋战，没有民主党领袖的支持。

sentences.en: He will be ripping apart his party if he wants to do this.
sentences.zh: 如果他想这么做，他就是在撕裂自己的党派。

sentences.en: Finally, Biden, who is still sick and weakened with COVID, says to them, well, what would we tell the American people?
sentences.zh: 最后，仍然生病且因新冠而虚弱的拜登对他们说，那我们要对美国人民说些什么？

sentences.en: Meaning if we were to drop out.
sentences.zh: 意思是如果我们退选的话。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: What would we say?
sentences.zh: 我们要说什么？

sentences.en: And that's really the first moment that Biden wants to see something on paper that is an announcement that he would be leaving the race.
sentences.zh: 这确实是拜登第一次想要在纸面上看到一份宣布他将退出竞选的声明。

sentences.en: The president says to them that he wants to sleep on it and they let him go upstairs.
sentences.zh: 总统对他们说他想考虑一晚，他们便让他上楼去。

sentences.en: He's sleeping in a spare bedroom because he has COVID.
sentences.zh: 因为得了新冠，他睡在一间客房里。

sentences.en: So he's alone.
sentences.zh: 所以他是孤身一人。

sentences.en: So he's alone on one of the most important nights of his life.
sentences.zh: 在他一生中最重要的几个夜晚之一，他是孤身一人。

sentences.en: And, you know, people close enough to him to know his thinking in this moment have told me that it was not decided, but everybody sort of knew where he was going.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，那些足够了解他此时想法的身边人告诉我，当时并没有做出决定，但每个人其实都知道他的倾向。

sentences.en: The next morning he gets up, the letter gets finalized and it is published on X exactly one minute after he calls into a senior staff meeting and is reading the letter to them,
sentences.zh: 第二天早上他起床了，信件敲定了，并在他打电话给高级员工会议并向他们宣读这封信、

sentences.en: telling them that he is leaving the race.
sentences.zh: 告诉他们自己要退出竞选整整一分钟后，在X上发布了。

sentences.en: So it sounds like the calculations for him are not about winning or losing, but really about the party and party unity and not wanting to, as you say, rip it apart.
sentences.zh: 听起来他的权衡不是关于输赢，而是关于党派和党内团结，正如你所说，不想撕裂它。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: What do we know about how he's been feeling about that decision since then?
sentences.zh: 关于他从那以后对这个决定有何感受，我们知道些什么？

sentences.en: That was a month ago, as we said.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所说，那是一个月前的事了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So in the moment, you know, it's been described to me as peace, a sense of understanding that he was not willing to do what would have been required of him politically
sentences.zh: 所以在当时，你知道，有人向我描述说是一种平静，一种理解感，即他不愿去做政治上要求他做的事

sentences.en: to keep going.
sentences.zh: 来继续坚持下去。

sentences.en: And I think in the weeks since,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为在之后的几周里，

sentences.en: I think he has experienced a mixture of emotions.
sentences.zh: 我认为他体验到了各种情绪的混合。

sentences.en: The president, it should be noted, I think is a pretty proud person.
sentences.zh: 应当指出，总统是一个相当骄傲的人。

sentences.en: There was a really big day a few weeks ago where three American hostages were released from Russian custody as part of a really complicated seven-nation prisoner swap.
sentences.zh: 几周前有一个非常大的日子，作为一项极其复杂的七国囚犯交换协议的一部分，三名美国人质从俄罗斯的羁押中获释。

sentences.en: That is, you know, as Jake Sullivan, the president's national security advisor, was fighting back tears, talking to us that day, saying, this is vintage Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 那就是，你知道的，正如总统国家安全顾问杰克·沙利文那天对我们说话时强忍着泪水所说的那样，这是最经典的乔·拜登。

sentences.en: This is what he's best at.
sentences.zh: 这是他最擅长的。

sentences.en: Complicated foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 复杂的对外政策。

sentences.en: That was a moment for somebody like Biden to say, hey, I'm still the president.
sentences.zh: 对于像拜登这样的人来说，这是一个时刻，可以去说，嘿，我依然是总统。

sentences.en: And I was on the tarmac at, you know, midnight when those hostages came off and was talking about the importance of allies, the importance of diplomatic relationships,
sentences.zh: 而且我在那些人质走下飞机时，你知道的，在午夜时分站在停机坪上，谈论着盟友的重要性、外交关系的重要性，

sentences.en: essentially saying, the importance of my experience is this.
sentences.zh: 本质上是在说，我的经验的重要性就在于此。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And if you know how he approaches politics, you know that he is saying in that moment, I have value.
sentences.zh: 如果你知道他对待政治的方式，你就会知道他当时是在说，我有价值。

sentences.en: This is what I bring.
sentences.zh: 这就是我带来的东西。

sentences.en: This is what I am good at.
sentences.zh: 这就是我擅长的。

sentences.en: And he wants the chances to be able to say that.
sentences.zh: 他想要有机会能够说出这一点。

sentences.en: It's like he's sending a message to the people who pushed him out.
sentences.zh: 就像他在向那些逼他下台的人发信息一样。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全是。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And speaking of the people who pushed him out, you know, I think there are people close to the president who, you know, have told me as much,
sentences.zh: 说到那些逼他下台的人，你知道，我想总统身边的人，你知道，也曾这样对我说过，

sentences.en: saying this party will have to reconcile with what it did to a sitting president who the voters had chosen.
sentences.zh: 说这个党将不得不去调和它对一位选民所选择的现任总统所做的事情。

sentences.en: And, you know, I think that there is definite resentment,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我认为确实存在怨恨、

sentences.en: frustration, distruSt.
sentences.zh: 沮丧和不信任。

sentences.en: Former President Obama was somebody who was making a lot of calls to party leaders, including, you know, he was in touch with the vice president in the days
sentences.zh: 前总统奥巴马曾频繁致电党内领袖，包括，你知道，在总统决定退选前的几天里他与副总统保持着联系。

sentences.en: before the president decided to drop out.
sentences.zh: 在总统决定退选前。

sentences.en: There is definitely a sense of resentment toward Nancy Pelosi, the former House Speaker, for saying things like, well, you know, if he does drop out,
sentences.zh: 对于前众议院议长南希·佩洛西，有一种明显的怨恨情绪，因为她说过这样的话，嗯，你知道，如果他真的退选了，

sentences.en: I think we should have an open convention.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们应该举行一次开放式代表大会。

sentences.en: Basically, before he's even made the decision to say, well, here's how it could look and what I think.
sentences.zh: 基本上，在他甚至还没做出决定的时候，就抢先说，嗯，事情可以这样，我是这么想的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对吧。

sentences.en: He just sort of is pushed out, right?
sentences.zh: 他有点像被逼走的，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So one of the things he did is saying,
sentences.zh: 所以他所做的事情之一，就是说，

sentences.en: I fully support the vice president as the person to carry on my legacy and to win this election and prevent another term for Trump.
sentences.zh: 我全力支持副总统作为继承我的政治遗产、赢得这次选举并阻止特朗普再干一届的人选。

sentences.en: And it really shut down talk of other people jumping into this race.
sentences.zh: 这确实扼杀了其他人想要跳进这场竞选的言论。

sentences.en: She locked it up.
sentences.zh: 她把局势稳稳拿下了。

sentences.en: There's got to be a land speed record for that.
sentences.zh: 这方面肯定得有个陆地速度纪录。

sentences.en: You know, there were these conversations about we don't want it to be a coronation, but, you know, it was pretty close.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，曾有过这样的讨论：我们不希望这是一场加冕礼，但你知道的，这其实也差不远了。

sentences.en: And that is because Biden made the strongest case he could for her.
sentences.zh: 那是因为拜登为她做了他所能做出的最有力辩护。

sentences.en: At a moment where the Democratic Party had leaders saying, well, let's do this, or I would like this, or maybe this person.
sentences.zh: 当时民主党内有领袖说，嗯，咱们这么办吧，或者我想要这样，又或者是也许选这个人。

sentences.en: And Biden all but said, well, no, we're going with my person.
sentences.zh: 而拜登几乎是直接说，嗯，不，我们就选我支持的人。

sentences.en: We're going with the vice president I picked.
sentences.zh: 我们就选我挑的副总统。

sentences.en: So again, he doesn't want to see this party infighting.
sentences.zh: 所以再次说明，他不想看到党内出现内讧。

sentences.en: He endorses her so that there's not this nasty public battle, right?
sentences.zh: 他公开背书她，好让大家不至于闹出难看的公开争斗，对吧？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Again, unity.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，为了团结。

sentences.en: It was a unity play.
sentences.zh: 这是一次主打团结的操作。

sentences.en: And it was, again, a fear of his that this would happen should he not really make a strong case for her.
sentences.zh: 而且，这也是他的一大担忧：如果他不切实为她全力背书，这种情况就会发生。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's interesting because, you know, the reporting we had leading up was also that he privately did not necessarily believe that Harris could win
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，这很有意思，因为根据我们之前收到的报道，他在私下里其实也并非一定相信哈里斯能够获胜，

sentences.en: and got to this point by the time he decided to leave the race that he clearly believed that she was the one who could.
sentences.zh: 直到他决定退出竞选时，他才走到了这一步，他显然坚信她才是那个能赢的人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So in a way, one way of looking at this convention is that it's not his convention, but he did have a big hand in making it her convention.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种程度上看，看待这次大会的一个视角是：这虽然不是他的大会，但他确实在把它变成她的大会方面出了大力。

sentences.en: I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 我认为确实如此。

sentences.en: It's definitely not his big event to headline anymore.
sentences.zh: 这绝对不再是他作为主角的大型活动了。

sentences.en: You know, he's coming in as not the change candidate that so many Democrats are seeing in Harris now, but as sort of this
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他登场时不再是许多民主党人如今在哈里斯身上看到的变革型候选人，而更像是一个

sentences.en: throwback figure almost that is passing the baton to her.
sentences.zh: 几乎是将火炬传递给她的回归传统式人物。

sentences.en: And I think he sees the vice president as somebody who is best positioned to carry forward his legacy.
sentences.zh: 我想他把副总统看作是传承他政治遗产的最佳人选。

sentences.en: She's taking the baton from me.
sentences.zh: 她从我手中接过了火炬。

sentences.en: I save democracy.
sentences.zh: 我拯救了民主。

sentences.en: She will preserve it.
sentences.zh: 她将延续民主。

sentences.en: You know, and inside the United Center where we are, delegates who are arriving are getting little coffee bean packets that say Cup of Joe on them.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在我们身处的联合中心球馆内，到场的代表们正收到印有“乔之杯”字样的小咖啡豆包。

sentences.en: And the digital banners will say spread the faith and a couple other BidenisMs.
sentences.zh: 数字横幅上会写着“传递信念”以及其他几个拜登式的口号。

sentences.en: And then they go dark when he's done and they flip over to Harris Walls and the sort of messages associated with her campaign.
sentences.zh: 然后，当他发言完毕，它们就会变暗，并切换成哈里斯的口号以及与她竞选相关的信息。

sentences.en: So there's a lot of talk of gratitude for him.
sentences.zh: 所以有很多表达对他的感激之情的话题。

sentences.en: The thing is, though, is that Joe Biden has been around long enough to understand that the second beat to thank you so much is thank you so much for dropping a campaign
sentences.zh: 不过问题在于，乔·拜登在政坛混迹够久了，他心里明白，紧接着“非常感谢”之后的第二重潜台词是：非常感谢你终于放弃了一场

sentences.en: that Democratic voters did not believe in.
sentences.zh: 民主党选民根本不相信的竞选活动。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for getting off the stage.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你主动下台。

sentences.en: And for somebody like him, that has got to be very bittersweet and a tough moment to get through.
sentences.zh: 而对于像他这样的人来说，这必定是苦乐参半、极难熬过去的一个时刻。

sentences.en: Katie, thank you.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: So right now we're at the arena and we are about to go inside to talk to delegates.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们在场馆内，正准备进去和代表们交流。

sentences.en: These are people who will formalize
sentences.zh: 这些人将正式确认

sentences.en: Kamala Harris's nomination.
sentences.zh: 卡玛拉·哈里斯的提名。

sentences.en: And we are going to talk to them about Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 我们要和他们聊聊关于乔·拜登的话题。

sentences.en: How are people seeing him in this moment?
sentences.zh: 此时此刻大家是怎么看他的？

sentences.en: Hi, are you a delegate?
sentences.zh: 嗨，你是代表吗？

sentences.en: I am a delegate.
sentences.zh: 我是代表。

sentences.en: Where are you from?
sentences.zh: 你来自哪里？

sentences.en: Michigan.
sentences.zh: 密歇根州。

sentences.en: Michigan.
sentences.zh: 密歇根州。

sentences.en: The great state of Michigan.
sentences.zh: 伟大的密歇根州。

sentences.en: Okay, my name is Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 好的，我叫萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: Hi, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 嗨，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: Hi, Bob.
sentences.zh: 嗨，鲍勃。

sentences.en: Nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴认识你。

sentences.en: Well, his name is Rob.
sentences.zh: 呃，他叫罗布。

sentences.en: Oh, Rob.
sentences.zh: 噢，罗布。

sentences.en: I'll take Bob.
sentences.zh: 叫我鲍勃也行。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah, whatever.
sentences.zh: 行吧，都行。

sentences.en: Snob.
sentences.zh: 势利眼。

sentences.en: So, a question for you.
sentences.zh: 那么，问你一个问题。

sentences.en: One word to describe Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 用一个词来形容乔·拜登。

sentences.en: If you had one word, what would it be?
sentences.zh: 如果你只有一个词，会是什么？

sentences.en: Courageous.
sentences.zh: 勇敢。

sentences.en: Delawarean?
sentences.zh: 特拉华州人？

sentences.en: He is an American patriot.
sentences.zh: 他是一位美国爱国者。

sentences.en: He has been such an incredible leader for our nation for years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，他一直是我们国家不可思议的杰出领袖。

sentences.en: He's been an amazing public servant.
sentences.zh: 他是一位了不起的公仆。

sentences.en: I'm a little misty.
sentences.zh: 我有点热泪盈眶了。

sentences.en: I have such affection for him.
sentences.zh: 我对他的感情太深了。

sentences.en: I was sad, very sad, to see him make the decision he made, but he made the right decision for the country.
sentences.zh: 看到他作出那样的决定，我很难过，非常难过，但他为国家作出了正确的决定。

sentences.en: In some ways, does part of you wish he was the nominee still?
sentences.zh: 从某种角度来说，你内心深处有没有哪怕一点希望他依然是候选人？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: No, because the election has turned on a dime.
sentences.zh: 没有，因为选举局势瞬间扭转了。

sentences.en: It's going in the right direction now.
sentences.zh: 现在正朝着正确的方向发展。

sentences.en: It was going in a very bad direction before.
sentences.zh: 之前的发展方向非常糟糕。

sentences.en: I mean, in less than a month, she's turned over this campaign.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在不到一个月的时间里，她就把这场竞选盘活了。

sentences.en: She's brought people together in just incredible ways.
sentences.zh: 她以令人难以置信的方式将人们凝聚在了一起。

sentences.en: Now, that's not to take away from Joe Biden or to say, I mean, I love Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 当然，这并不是要抹杀乔·拜登，也不是说……我是说，我爱乔·拜登。

sentences.en: How is it going to feel tonight watching him speak?
sentences.zh: 今晚看着他演讲，会有什么感觉？

sentences.en: I don't know, but I brought Kleenex.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，但我带了纸巾。

sentences.en: I think we're all here to give him his flowers, to say thank you.
sentences.zh: 我想我们大家来这里都是为了向他致敬，向他道谢。

sentences.en: We're going to be proud for him.
sentences.zh: 我们会为他感到骄傲。

sentences.en: It's a valedictory, and he's deserved it and earned it.
sentences.zh: 这是一场告别演说，这是他应得的荣誉。

sentences.en: I think that there's going to be an incredible outpouring of love, respect, and honor
sentences.zh: 我想大家会向他倾注难以置信的爱戴、

sentences.en: for him.
sentences.zh: 敬意与尊崇。

sentences.en: I'm not sad for him.
sentences.zh: 我并不为他感到难过。

sentences.en: I'm proud of him.
sentences.zh: 我为他感到骄傲。

sentences.en: I'm just, I'm like,
sentences.zh: 我只是，我感觉……

sentences.en: I'm in awe of him, really.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我对他充满敬畏。

sentences.en: I am, and I think we're living history right now.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，而且我觉得我们正在见证历史。

sentences.en: I mean, we're living history tonight.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们今晚正在见证历史。

sentences.en: I think the history is going to show,
sentences.zh: 我认为历史将会证明，

sentences.en: wow, what an incredible gift that Joe Biden has given us.
sentences.zh: 哇，乔·拜登给我们的馈赠是多么不可思议。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是威娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏板块的拼字游戏《Connections》，而且我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，也喜欢尝试难倒你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基，我每天创作

sentences.en: Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 拼字游戏《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called Chromesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“色觉体验”的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到声音的这些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com 休闲游戏频道，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: So, we are walking to the arena from the press center.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们正从新闻中心步行前往场馆。

sentences.en: I'm walking with my friend and admired colleague
sentences.zh: 我和我的朋友兼受人尊敬的同事

sentences.en: Peter Baker.
sentences.zh: 彼得·贝克一起走着。

sentences.en: An admirer.
sentences.zh: 承蒙夸奖。

sentences.en: I'm an admirer of you.
sentences.zh: 我也很敬佩你。

sentences.en: And we are first going to have a conversation, and then we're going to go in to watch Biden's speech together.
sentences.zh: 我们打算先聊聊天，然后一起进去观看拜登的演讲。

sentences.en: Okay, so we're going to talk to Peter about what he expects from the speech tonight.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们要和彼得谈谈他对今晚演讲的期望。

sentences.en: What do you expect, Peter?
sentences.zh: 你有什么期望，彼得？

sentences.en: Oh, well, look, it's a really fascinating moment, right, because Joe Biden has been coming to conventions like this since 1972.
sentences.zh: 噢，好吧，你看，这真的是一个极其迷人的时刻，对吧，因为乔·拜登从1972年就开始参加这样的大会了。

sentences.en: He's given a lot of speeches.
sentences.zh: 他发表过很多演讲。

sentences.en: But this is the first one where he has to basically give a speech saying,
sentences.zh: 但这是他第一次必须发表这样一场演讲：

sentences.en: I'm done.
sentences.zh: 我卸任了。

sentences.en: And it's something he's always resisted.
sentences.zh: 而这是他一向抗拒的事情。

sentences.en: His whole thesis of his political career, his whole life, really, is if you're knocked down, you get back up.
sentences.zh: 他整个政治生涯的核心理念，甚至可以说是他一生的全部，就是如果你被打倒了，你就要站起来。

sentences.en: Well, now he's going to say, okay, this is the end for me after more than 50 years on the public stage.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在他要说，好吧，在公众舞台上活跃了50多年之后，对我来说这就是终点站了。

sentences.en: So he's speaking to a couple different audiences.
sentences.zh: 所以他在向几个不同的受众喊话。

sentences.en: One, of course, is the audience here in the hall and the national audience watching on television.
sentences.zh: 其一，当然是现场大厅里的观众以及通过电视观看的全国观众。

sentences.en: And he's going to try to frame his accomplishments and pass the torch to Kamala Harris.
sentences.zh: 他将试图总结自己的成就，并把火炬交接给卡玛拉·哈里斯。

sentences.en: And the second audience he's talking to really is history.
sentences.zh: 而他真正对话的第二个受众其实是历史。

sentences.en: He's trying to say, who is Joe Biden?
sentences.zh: 他试图阐明：乔·拜登是谁？

sentences.en: What did it matter that he was president for four years?
sentences.zh: 他当了四年总统究竟有什么意义？

sentences.en: Where does he fit in our national story?
sentences.zh: 他在我们的国家叙事中处于什么位置？

sentences.en: And it's going to be a really fascinating speech to watch.
sentences.zh: 这将是一场非常引人入胜、值得观看的演讲。

sentences.en: And what do you make of the fact that it's happening on Monday, the first day of the convention?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于这件事发生在周一——大会的第一天，你作何感想？

sentences.en: But, you know, this is the day they've chosen for him.
sentences.zh: 不过，你知道的，这是他们为他选定的日子。

sentences.en: Yeah, Monday is, of course, a demotion, right?
sentences.zh: 对，周一当然算是一种降级，对吧？

sentences.en: He expected to give his speech on Thursday when he was going to accept the nomination.
sentences.zh: 他原本预计在周四接受提名时发表他的演讲。

sentences.en: That's the big night.
sentences.zh: 那是重头戏之夜。

sentences.en: That's the night you want to give a speech.
sentences.zh: 那是你想发表演讲的夜晚。

sentences.en: He's been demoted to Monday, which is usually the night for the formers.
sentences.zh: 他被降级到了周一，这一天通常是留给卸任政要的夜晚。

sentences.en: And you can already see in the last few weeks, if you go to the White House every day or you watch him give his public presentations, what few he's done, you can feel the energy
sentences.zh: 你已经在过去几周里看得很清楚了，如果你每天去白宫或者看他发表公开演讲——尽管他没做过几次——你就能感受到能量、

sentences.en: and the power and the attention drifting away from him.
sentences.zh: 权力和关注点正在从他身上流失。

sentences.en: And it's a palpable thing when a president becomes a lame duck and you really have seen it these last few weeks and now tonight he'll get up there, he'll give his speech
sentences.zh: 当一位总统变成跛脚鸭时，这种感觉是显而易见的，过去几周你确实看得很真切；而现在今晚他将走上台，发表他的演讲，

sentences.en: and then he's going to get on a plane later tonight and he's going to head off to California and he won't be here for the rest of the convention.
sentences.zh: 然后他会在今晚晚些时候登上一架飞机，前往加利福尼亚州，接下来的整场大会他都不会再出席。

sentences.en: He's going to literally cede the stage of Kamala Harris and it's the symbolic way the Democratic Party is going to say we're moving on.
sentences.zh: 他将字面意义上把舞台让给卡玛拉·哈里斯，这是民主党人宣告“我们要向前看了”的象征性方式。

sentences.en: All right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: The Joe Biden era is essentially over now and we're moving on to the Kamala Harris era and he will be on vacation.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登时代现在基本上已经结束了，我们正迈向卡玛拉·哈里斯时代，而他则要去度假了。

sentences.en: You won't see him in public really again until Labor Day.
sentences.zh: 直到劳动节之前，你基本上不会在公共场合再见到他了。

sentences.en: I guess, Peter, you know, it is really a fundamentally human moment that we're witnessing here, right?
sentences.zh: 我想，彼得，你知道的，我们在这里见证的确实是一个极其人性化的时刻，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, this is a man who had all of these years in public service and the one thing he wanted most in the world was this, that he's now giving up and that feels really just
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个将所有岁月奉献给公共服务的男人，而他世上最渴望的东西就是这个，现在却要拱手让人，从历史的长河来看，这让人感慨万千，也是一个非常人性化的时刻。

sentences.en: in the sweep of history pretty remarkable and a very human moment.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: Yeah, it really is.
sentences.zh: 从某种程度上说，这是最具人情味的故事。

sentences.en: In some ways it's the most human story.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这也是我们所有人的故事，因为我们所有人终究都会耗尽时间，对吧？

sentences.en: It's actually all of our story because all of us eventually are going to run out of time, right?
sentences.zh: 他在公众生活中度过了半个世纪，顺便说一句，比他之前的任何一位总统都要长。

sentences.en: He has been in public life for a half century, more than any other president before him by the way.
sentences.zh: 当这个会场里的许多人还是小孩子的时候，他就已经在竞选总统了。

sentences.en: He has been running for president since a lot of people in this arena were children.
sentences.zh: 他的第一次竞选是在1987年。

sentences.en: His first campaign was in 1987.
sentences.zh: 当然，他的第二次竞选是在2008年。

sentences.en: His second one, of course, was in 2008.
sentences.zh: 他两次都没有获胜。

sentences.en: He didn't win either time.
sentences.zh: 最终，他在2020年赢了。

sentences.en: Finally, he wins in 2020.
sentences.zh: 所以，当要说出“好吧”时……

sentences.en: And so to say, okay,
sentences.zh: （译文占位符或截断处的延续）

sentences.en: I'm going to give it up after spending a lifetime of trying to get there, it goes against the grain.
sentences.zh: 在一生都在努力争取之后，我却要放弃它，这与我的直觉背道而驰。

sentences.en: It's completely against everything that he sees in himself.
sentences.zh: 这完全违背了他对自己的认知。

sentences.en: His life has been full of tragedy and setback followed by comeback and resilience.
sentences.zh: 他的一生充满了悲剧与挫折，随后又是一次次卷土重来与坚韧不拔。

sentences.en: And here is the first time he is not bouncing back.
sentences.zh: 而这一次是他头一次没能反弹。

sentences.en: So he's done the one thing that he prided himself on never doing.
sentences.zh: 所以他做了一件他一直引以为傲、发誓绝不做的事。

sentences.en: But at some point, you cannot outrace time.
sentences.zh: 但在某些时刻，你无法跑过时间。

sentences.en: You cannot outrace the impact of age.
sentences.zh: 你无法跑过岁月带来的影响。

sentences.en: And as much as he wanted to stay on the stage, his time has come.
sentences.zh: 尽管他多么想留在舞台上，但他的时刻已经到了。

sentences.en: And he's had to accept that.
sentences.zh: 而他不得不接受这一点。

sentences.en: And it's not an easy thing to do.
sentences.zh: 这可不是一件容易的事。

sentences.en: But tonight kind of brings that to the fore in a very public way.
sentences.zh: 但今晚以一种非常公开的方式把这一点摆到了台面上。

sentences.en: And he's, I think, going to use his opportunity to frame that exit.
sentences.zh: 而且我想，他打算利用这个机会来为这次退场定调。

sentences.en: Okay, let's watch that speech.
